description: This Java source file implements the ValueLinkApi class, providing functionality for encryption, decryption, key generation, and communication with the ValueLink third-party payment system, including handling key exchange, encryption/decryption routines, and response parsing.

classes.name: ValueLinkApi
classes.description: Implements encryption, key exchange, request transmission, and response parsing for the ValueLink third-party payment integration.

methods.name: encryptPin
methods.description: Encrypts a PIN using configured keys and crypto routines, returning a hex string for transmission.

methods.name: decryptPin
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted PIN hex string back to plain text using the configured keys.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request to the ValueLink URL with specified request parameters.

methods.name: outputKeyCreation
methods.description: Outputs cryptographic keys and parameters for manual database setup or testing.

methods.name: createKeys
methods.description: Generates a public/private key pair based on parameters provided by ValueLink.

methods.name: generateKek
methods.description: Creates a shared secret key (KEK) for encrypting sensitive data using Diffie-Hellman key exchange.

methods.name: getValueLinkPublicKey
methods.description: Retrieves the public key provided by ValueLink for cryptographic operations.

methods.name: getPrivateKey
methods.description: Loads the private key for the merchant from stored configuration.

methods.name: generateMwk
methods.description: Creates a new Message Working Key (MWK), encrypted for secure storage and transmission.

methods.name: encryptViaKek
methods.description: Encrypts data using the KEK.

methods.name: decryptViaKek
methods.description: Decrypts data encrypted with the KEK.

methods.name: getDateString
methods.description: Returns the current timestamp formatted according to ValueLink specifications.

methods.name: getWorkingKeyIndex
methods.description: Retrieves the index of the current working key used for cryptographic operations.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Converts a BigDecimal amount into a ValueLink formatted string.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Converts a ValueLink formatted amount string back into a BigDecimal.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Returns the currency code formatted for ValueLink (currently hardcoded).

methods.name: getInitialRequestMap
methods.description: Generates the initial request map with merchant info, timestamp, and transaction details.

methods.name: getGenericValue
methods.description: Loads the cached database record for merchant key info.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Resets cached keys to force re-initialization.

methods.name: getDHParameterSpec
methods.description: Creates Diffie-Hellman parameters from property values for key exchange.

methods.name: cryptoViaKek
methods.description: Performs encryption or decryption using the KEK and a provided mode.

methods.name: getCipher
methods.description: Creates an initialized Cipher object for DESede with CBC mode and no padding.

methods.name: getPinCheckSum
methods.description: Computes a checksum byte of the PIN bytes.

methods.name: getRandomBytes
methods.description: Generates a byte array of specified length filled with secure random bytes.

methods.name: getMwkKey
methods.description: Returns the decoded MWK as a SecretKey object.

methods.name: getKekKey
methods.description: Returns the decoded KEK as a SecretKey object.

methods.name: getDesEdeKey
methods.description: Creates a SecretKey from byte array for DESede encryption.

methods.name: getMwk
methods.description: Returns the stored MWK bytes from the cached database record.

methods.name: getKek
methods.description: Returns the stored KEK bytes from the cached database record.

methods.name: getPrivateKeyBytes
methods.description: Returns the stored private key bytes from database record.

methods.name: parseResponse
methods.description: Parses the HTML response from ValueLink into a map of key-value pairs.
